name: projektbox
description: ProjektBox - Monorepo für ProjektBox TV, ProjektBox Smartphone & Backend Server (Neon PostgreSQL)

scripts.build:tv: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/tv run build
scripts.build:smartphone: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/smartphone run build
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix apps/tv run build && npm --prefix apps/smartphone run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n "SERVER,PHONE,TV" -c "green.bold,cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:smartphone" "npm run dev:tv"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/tv run lint && npm --prefix apps/smartphone run lint && npx oxlint packages/shared/src packages/ui/src server/src
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix server test
